title: City of Laredo Offices Closed Thanksgiving Day and Friday; Trash, Landfill and El Metro Also Closed Thursday
excerpt: The City of Laredo's administrative offices will be closed Thursday, Nov. 26, and Friday, Nov. 27, in observance of Thanksgiving. Regular business operations re
content:
The City of Laredo's administrative offices will be closed Thursday, Nov. 26, and Friday, Nov. 27, in observance of Thanksgiving.

Regular business operations resume Monday, Nov. 30.

On Thursday, Nov. 26, there will be no recycling collection, solid waste services will be closed, the landfill will be closed, there will be no recycling drop-off and no 3-1-1 services, and El Metro Transit will have no services.

On Saturday, Nov. 28, recycling drop-off and the landfill will be available, weather permitting.

The city wished residents a safe and joyful Thanksgiving.

Source: City of Laredo.
